application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use - offices to dwellinghouses
description: Prior Notification for the change of use of offices (Class B1a)  to form 135 apartments (Class C3).
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The development hereby approved shall be completed within three years of the date of this granting of prior approval.

Condition : 2 - 2.	No dwelling shall be occupied until a Car Parking Management Plan that includes details of how car parking spaces are to be allocated to residents, how parking, deliveries and waiting on the internal roads is to be managed to ensure access is not obstructed, and other measures to monitor and enforce parking within the site has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Parking and deliveries on the site shall be operated in accordance with the approved Car Parking Management Plan.

Condition : 3 - 3.	Prior to the first occupation of the flats hereby permitted, full details of cycle parking provision (including enclosure details) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout, and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development hereby approved and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - 5.	Prior to the first occupation of any part of the development hereby approved a Travel Plan shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 6 - 6.	Prior to the first occupation of any part of the development hereby approved, the following flood risk mitigation measures shall be implemented: 
a)	Raising gas and electricity meters above 7.61m AOD. 
b)	Raising power sockets above 7.61m AOD. 
c)	Plant rooms to be surveyed to assess any water entry points and vulnerable services that may be impacted by flood water. Flood resistance and resilient measures should be considered to mitigate any risk to plant rooms. 
d)	All of the occupants of the development shall be informed about the Floodline Warning Direct.
